description.value: Bar Gobo is a Michelin Guide 2025-listed Hi-Fi wine bar in Vancouver's East Side, pouring wine and cocktails alongside food in a room tuned for acoustic performance using vintage high-fidelity gear including 1972 Altec Lansing speakers and a Dynaco tube amplifier. The music program is curated live on vinyl by a resident enthusiast, giving the space an intimate, unpredictable character that sets it apart from conventional bars. A touring cyclist finishing a day's ride on the nearby Seaside Greenway or Central Valley Greenway would find a sophisticated but relaxed spot for an evening glass.
